Create an independent session from the current conversation history. The original session and draft are preserved.
This removes this message and all later conversation history permanently. Workspace files keep their current contents.
The native history boundary is ambiguous. HAPI did not rewind this session. To fork the current history, return to the session list, long-press the session and choose Fork session.
The rewind result needs reconciliation. Refresh from the Hub before continuing; this does not submit another rewind.
The session changed. Close this dialog and choose the history action again.
